architectureConstraints: fileRestructure.md sections 6 and 7.1: apps/venue-connector/ is a legacy external-POS project classified RETIRE. This story does not retire it, extend it or relocate it
Epic 1 context: green honestly. No test is skipped, filtered, weakened or edited, no job is set to continue on error, and no lint or warning is suppressed

acceptanceCriteria.given: the Venue Connector solution at the candidate, built and tested on a non-Windows host with the .NET SDK
acceptanceCriteria.then: every test passes and none is skipped: at least the 502 tests present at the baseline, plus the new regression test

acceptanceCriteria.given: the 3 tests that fail at the baseline (NativeTerminalBindingEvidenceTests: WhenTheExpectedExecutableOwnsTheVb6Windows_TheEvidenceIsConsistent, NonVb6Windows_AreNotCountedAsNativeTerminalOwners, MultipleOwners_AreAllReported_MostWindowsFirst)
acceptanceCriteria.when: they run unchanged against the baseline code and then against the candidate code, on the same non-Windows host
acceptanceCriteria.then: they fail on the baseline and pass on the candidate, and their source file is byte-for-byte unchanged

acceptanceCriteria.given: a window inventory whose visible VB6-class windows are owned by a Windows executable path (for example C:\Idealpos Solutions\Idealpos 8\IPSClient.exe) while the expected executable is IPS.exe
acceptanceCriteria.when: the native-terminal binding evidence is summarized on any host OS
acceptanceCriteria.then: the owner is reported by its executable file name (IPSClient.exe), its full path is kept as given, and the report states a contradiction. The same Windows path yields the same file name, presence and verdict on every host, and the results on Windows are unchanged

acceptanceCriteria.given: the candidate compared with the baseline
acceptanceCriteria.when: the CI workflow, the connector's solution and project files, the build, NuGet and test-runner configuration, the existing test files and the Windows-only connector projects are inspected
acceptanceCriteria.then: none of them has changed, and no skip, focus or suppression has been added

completionCriteria: The evaluator's venue-connector-dotnet check (dotnet-test runner on VerduraIdealposTracer.slnx, Release) passes on the candidate with at least 503 tests executed, none failed and none skipped
RT1 to RT4 fail on the baseline and pass on the candidate on the evaluation host (a non-Windows host: on Windows, RT1 to RT4 would already pass on the baseline)
No forbidden surface, CI definition, build or project definition, existing test or governance path is changed
Technical completion is the evaluator's decision CANDIDATE_READY_FOR_ACCEPTANCE only. Proof that the GitHub job is green needs an authorized push and is the orchestrator's decision
